gotchas: Sign-in at roblox.com/login: #login-username takes the recorded handle (tokens.username), #login-password, then #login-button. On 2026-10-11 it landed signed in with no PerimeterX puzzle; when the Press & Hold (#px-captcha) does appear it is the account owner's to solve in a handoff, and Log In must be pressed again right after it.

On 2026-10-11 the first sign-in of a session did not hold: the next page load of roblox.com/upgrades/robux or /home came up signed out (login form shown). Signing in a second time held, and from then on opening /upgrades/robux directly stayed signed in. Check #nav-settings on the Robux page before choosing a package.

The Robux packages are buttons whose label is the price in the egress's local currency (CHF from a Swiss egress on 2026-10-11); the route's CHF selector is locale-specific, so on another egress pick a package button by its currency text. The first button is the smallest package.

Choosing a package opens a Stripe Payment Element on the page (one iframe titled 'Secure payment input frame' holding input[name=number], input[name=expiry], input[name=cvc]; no postal or country field showed) above a 'Pay' submit.
Verified 2026-10-11 through the staging proxy with the public test card under a verification-only key: expiry, number and CVC filled (card_fields_verified). Stopped before Pay.
